name: Bulimia
overview: Scripture affirms that each person is fearfully and wonderfully made by God, a truth that calls believers to honor their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to Him. In the struggle with bulimia, God's promise to strengthen, help, and uphold provides comfort and assurance, while the call to seek His kingdom first invites a transformation of the mind away from worldly patterns. Faith in Christ brings healing and wholeness, enabling believers to live in peace and reflect God's perfect will for their lives.
